title: Fit an Ice Harvester I at Node Alpha: the tool every ice field needs
note: A pilot without the module docks at the station, buys one Ice Harvester I and fits it beside its lasers (cpu 8 of 16, power 17 of 30 on a starter: game/routes/guidebook/mining.md, section 5). For the miner plan, where it stands before the ice routes (orders.log ENT-007, block ZERO). 2026-11-15 23:34 to 23:35 UTC at Central Nexus: six runs, four fitted (three at 1,427 cr with the tax, one at 1,755: the ask had moved to 1,738 while two pilots bought in the same tick, over the max_price of 1,700), two found no ask at 1,700 or less (view_market about 23:36 UTC: 1,738 x 4). 2026-11-15 23:36 UTC, Zero: the stop moved to Node Alpha (1,413 x 5 at the best price, 22:51 UTC; one jump from Nexus Prime), one ship at a time so that two buys never meet one ask. Four more runs at Central Nexus started before that change reached the dispatcher and found no ask (23:35:34 and 23:36:04 UTC): ten pilots had flown it, four fitted. A whole run counts as done even when nothing was bought (dispatch.py done_once), so those six are not sent again. max_pilots 12: two more pilots, for the two ice routes that had no ship. A pilot with a gas harvester and a mining laser has no slot left for this module: keep max_pilots closed while such a pilot is free. Raised when the ice routes' first RESULT lines lift their max_ships. max_pilots counts the pilots of every division: a division that adds this route asks Zero to raise it. 2026-11-16 00:30 UTC, Zero: max_pilots 12 -> 15 for the three asks at 1,413 cr that stood at Node Alpha at 00:27 UTC; the first ice routes paid +4,644 to +6,730 cr a run (runs.jsonl).
